_why: Drivers kept in source but left out of the Athom publish payload while they break Athom processing. Never-published drivers only (no paired device can depend on them). Re-enable by removing the entry once a dedicated bisect build passes.

drivers.reason: P3024 attempt 1 (25/10/2026): every master build after the 21/10 Athom incident (#3676-#3678, v9.0.1593-1595) added new never-published pairable driver ids on top of Test #3655 v9.0.1574 (347 -> 352 -> 356 drivers) and failed AggregateError; same pattern as SPI 9/9 and whd02/valve_5zone on 10-11/10. Held as one group to put the payload driver set back to the 1574 set. Never published (absent from test/fixtures/athom-test-9.0.1574-driver-ids.json); its couples are absent from 1574, so no paired device loses its driver. Graduate one id per release_held dispatch once a build reaches Test.
